title: Graph engineering — a work graph, host-neutral coordination, and an opt-in decider for parallel agent sessions

acceptance_criteria.then: it reads as version 2 with depends_on []

tests.name: reads a version-1 task as version 2 with no dependencies

acceptance_criteria.given: a worktree of the clone that has a task with slug s
acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel task new s runs in another worktree of the clone
acceptance_criteria.then: it exits 1 and writes no task

tests.name: task new refuses a slug that another worktree of the clone uses

acceptance_criteria.given: task b depends on task a
acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel task update a --depends-on b runs
acceptance_criteria.then: it exits 1 and writes no change

tests.name: task update refuses an edge that closes a cycle

acceptance_criteria.given: open task a, and open task b that depends on a
acceptance_criteria.then: a is ready and b is blocked by a

tests.name: task next lists a as ready and b as blocked by a

acceptance_criteria.given: a task that depends on owner/repo#123
acceptance_criteria.then: the task is blocked on that reference with state unknown, and no gh process starts

tests.name: an offline pull request reference is unknown and blocks without calling gh

acceptance_criteria.given: a fixture clone with 20 worktrees and 200 tasks
acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel task graph and dotbabel task next run offline
acceptance_criteria.then: each finishes in at most 1 second

tests.name: graph and next finish within 1 second for 20 worktrees and 200 tasks

acceptance_criteria.given: session A holds the merge token, and session B runs a token command
acceptance_criteria.when: the hook denies B and A's merge is then recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: B sees its queue position in the deny reason and is the only session that can take the freed token

tests.name: a blocked session sees its queue position, and only the head takes a freed token

acceptance_criteria.given: session B heads the queue with a reservation
acceptance_criteria.when: 10 minutes pass and B does not retry
acceptance_criteria.then: B loses the reservation and the next entry heads the queue

tests.name: a head that does not retry loses its reservation after 10 minutes

acceptance_criteria.given: a review finding with critical severity or no severity
acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel decide --step review-triage runs with any adapter answer

tests.name: a critical or missing severity always gets full-validation for any adapter answer

acceptance_criteria.given: a model adapter that does not answer within 5 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: it prints the built-in answer with fallback true and exits 0

tests.name: an adapter timeout returns the built-in answer with fallback true and exit 0

acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel decide, pr-stack record, and both exports run
acceptance_criteria.then: the key appears in no receipt, export file, or log line

tests.name: a canary key never reaches the receipt, an export, or a log line

acceptance_criteria.then: none of them imports the decider module

tests.name: no merge gate module imports the decider module
the package has four runtime dependencies

acceptance_criteria.given: an open task without a phase, an open task with a phase, and a closed task
acceptance_criteria.then: they map to TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED, TASK_STATE_WORKING, and TASK_STATE_COMPLETED

tests.name: the A2A export maps open, phase-set, and closed tasks
